note: Colours the phone artboards set directly that design/tokens.json does not carry. The artboard wins, so the theme uses them; each is proposed to mobile-lead for tokens.json. Generated into lib/theme/tokens.g.dart as VpArtboardColours.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.source: AppKeypad.dc.html and AppKeypadDark.dc.html .badge background (tab bar counts). Not danger-600 (#c62828).

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.source: AppKeypad.dc.html .tabs background var(--surface); AppKeypadDark.dc.html overrides it to #1a1613 (not surface ink-900).
